sentences.en: In addition to being a pianist, she is a painter.
sentences.zh: 除了是钢琴家外，她还是个画家。

sentences.en: In addition, there were two other deficiencies in that system.
sentences.zh: 此外，该系统还存在其他两个缺陷。

sentences.en: It is possible for us to do addition very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们有可能非常快速地进行加法运算。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：add（加）+ition（表名词）→加，增加
